messages:
Lee: Heads-up — BrightAd reporting ~120 users missing the 'editor' role after SCIM group sync. They say group shows up in Redwood UI but role isn't applied. Customer tried reproing by re-syncing, no change.

Maya: Ack. Can you paste the provisioning logs and the group->role mapping config from the tenant? Also which IdP (Okta/OneLogin)?

Lee: Okta. Here are the bits I pulled from the provisioning log (redacted):

```
2024-06-28T14:12:03Z INFO scim: received PATCH /Groups/00g1abcd
2024-06-28T14:12:03Z DEBUG scim.payload: {"schemas":["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"],"Operations":[{"op":"replace","path":"members","value":[{"value":"00u123","display":"jane.doe@brightad.com"}]}]}
2024-06-28T14:12:03Z DEBUG scim.group: externalId='brightad-editors '
2024-06-28T14:12:03Z WARN mapping: no role mapping found for group.externalId='brightad-editors '
```

Notice the trailing space on the externalId in the log. Customer says their Okta group name had a trailing space (accidental) and they never edited it after creation.

Maya: That trailing space would cause an exact-match mapping to fail if our mapper doesn't normalize. What's the mapping configured in their tenant?

Lee: In tenant UI mapping is configured to match on group.externalId == 'brightad-editors' -> role: editor. They set it up months ago. UI shows the mapping (no trim option).

Raj: Thanks — looks like two issues: 1) Okta allowed externalId with trailing whitespace, 2) our SCIM ingest code uses strict equality when resolving mapping. Quick repro: create group externalId 'foo ' (with trailing space) in Okta -> SCIM PATCH comes through with that exact value -> mapping on 'foo' doesn't match.

Siva: To add: our DB canonicalization step trims names for display but we never trim externalId before matching. This was intentional early on to avoid surprising collisions, but edge-case like accidental trailing space causes user-facing break.

Maya: Customer is asking for a workaround now. Can we suggest a quick customer-side fix?

Lee: Workarounds I suggested: 1) update the Okta group's externalId via Okta API to remove trailing space (PATCH /api/v1/groups/{id} with new "profile":{"externalId":"brightad-editors"}) OR 2) recreate the group without the trailing space then re-add members. Customer prefers not to recreate.

Raj: For a short-term server-side mitigation we could add a tolerant-match path: when exact match fails try trimmed(externalId) and collapsed-whitespace. That would be a small change (mapper layer). Longer-term we should normalize on ingest and backfill existing mappings.

Siva: Agreed. Proposed plan: A) hotfix in mapper to try trimmed match (can be feature-flagged), B) migration job to create normalized index (one-off), C) add validation doc for IdP setup to recommend no trailing whitespace.

Lee: Customer asked for ETA. Can we get a hotfix in canary today?

DeployBot: Canary window opens 2024-06-28T20:00Z. Patch size estimate: ~4 files changed in mapper; CI + canary ~3 hours.

Raj: I'll own the hotfix. I'll open INF-7823 and target the canary tonight. Quick pseudo-diff I plan to apply in mapper.resolveByExternalId:

```
- if mapping_exists(externalId): return mapping
+ if mapping_exists(externalId): return mapping
+ if mapping_exists(externalId.trim()): return mapping  # tolerate trailing/leading ws
+ if mapping_exists(collapsedWhitespace(externalId)): return mapping
```

I'll also add telemetry to emit when we hit a trimmed-match so we can identify affected tenants.

Maya: Perfect. For now I'll send BrightAd instructions for updating the Okta group's externalId via API and offer a manual one-off: our CS team can run a reconcile that maps the group for them if they prefer us to do it.

Lee: I'll inform customer and offer the reconcile. They're relieved. Also adding temporary note in ticket: do NOT delete group until reconcile completes.

OktaBot: Last webhook id for tenant brightad: WID-9f7a3. Received at 2024-06-28T14:12:03Z.

Siva: Post-mortem notes to include: how IdP quirks (trailing spaces) escaped onboarding docs, add unit tests for externalId whitespace cases, and add a healthcheck that flags any group.externalId containing leading/trailing whitespace.

Raj: INF-7823 created and assigned to me. I'll push the canary patch + telemetry tonight and report back in this thread. :bug: :eyes:

Maya: Thanks team. Closing loop with customer once canary is healthy or after they accept the reconcile.

Lee: I'll follow up. Thanks all.
